name: fastfind
description: Grounded file discovery for AI agents: instant whole-machine file & folder search over the NTFS $MFT with structured filters. Returns exact paths, size, mtime, and a dir rollup so agents stop probing with ls/grep/find.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Instant file/folder search with structured filters (ext, any_of, all_of, none_of, size, date, whole_word). Returns exact full paths plus size, mtime, and a dirs:{path:count} rollup.
